_doc: Asset kinds: the budget table from docs/art-style.md, machine-readable.
tris: [min, max] render triangles (colliders excluded). Over max fails the verifier;
under min is a warning. bevel: [min, max] metres, a guide for main-body edges;
default_bevel is what a part gets when it doesn't say. near: metres, the closest the kind is
usually seen from. detail_px: the detail size is this many pixels at near (85 deg vertical
FOV, 1440 lines: near * 1.27 mm per pixel), the smallest detail hb builds: narrower bevels
are dropped and auto lathe segments keep the silhouette within it. 2 for things in the world
(the low-poly lean), 1 for things held in front of the camera. bevel_segments: what a part
gets when it doesn't say: 1, a chamfer, for every kind. 2 rounds it; dropping it halved the
SMG (3756 -> 1772) for a difference only seen inside 0.5 m. Keep this in step with art-style.md.

weapon_part.doc: A swappable weapon part (barrel, magazine, stock, sight, muzzle device): a handheld's piece
